retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait featuring a centered subject with bold, yellow retro-script typography overlapping the top of the head.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered facial portrait against a stark white background, characterized by soft studio lighting and a prominent yellow script title that arches across the upper third of the frame, partially obscuring the subject's hair.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography overlapping the subject's hair to create depth
High-contrast between yellow text and dark hair
Symmetrical facial placement against a neutral void
Warm skin tones balanced by a cool white background
coreInvariants: Yellow fill with dark thin outline for display text
High-key white background with no visible horizon line
Subject looking off-camera to create narrative tension

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up headshot, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned at the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold yellow title, moves down to the subject's gaze, and follows the direction of the look toward the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white space surrounding the head, concentrated at the top corners.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-saturation accent text.

letterConstructionRules: High-contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'f' has a long, descending tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant script font used for maximum impact.
graphicDevices: Thin dark stroke around text to ensure legibility against white

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, retro brush feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a person with dark hair against a pure white background, looking slightly to the side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title in a bold yellow retro script with a thin dark outline across the top third of the image, overlapping the hair.

verificationChecks: Is the text yellow with a thin dark outline?
Does the text overlap the subject's hair?
Is the subject centered in a close-up crop?

mustRedesign: Do not use busy or textured backgrounds
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is not obscured by the face, only the hair.
Ensure the yellow is vibrant and not mustard-toned.
Verify the outline on the text is thin and consistent.
Confirm the subject's expression is neutral or contemplative.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + High-Key White Background + Overlapping Retro Script Title
